title: Restriction compatibility for scalar-extension twist sections
statement: The normalized scalar-extension section commutes with restriction to a smaller open.

source.place: Naturality of the comparison morphism and tensor-pullback section.

proof.text: Expand scalarExtensionTwistSection and use naturality of the comparison morphism together with the defining naturality of tensorPullbackSection; evaluate at the chosen point.

from.place: Restriction step of the local fraction argument.

lean.statement:
theorem scalarExtensionTwistSection_restrict
    {A B : Type u} [CommRing A] [CommRing B]
    {σ τ : Type u} [SetLike σ A] [AddSubgroupClass σ A]
    [SetLike τ B] [AddSubgroupClass τ B]
    {𝒜 : ℕ → σ} {ℬ : ℕ → τ} [GradedRing 𝒜] [GradedRing ℬ]
    (r : Proj ℬ ⟶ Proj 𝒜)
    (θ : ∀ j : ℤ, (tensorPullback r).obj (twist 𝒜 j) ≅ twist ℬ j)
    (j : ℤ) (U V : (Proj 𝒜).Opens) (e : V ≤ U)
    (s : Γ(twist 𝒜 j, U)) (x : r ⁻¹ᵁ V) :
    (scalarExtensionTwistSection r θ j V
      ((twist 𝒜 j).presheaf.map (homOfLE e).op s)).1 x =
      (scalarExtensionTwistSection r θ j U s).1
        ⟨x.1, Scheme.Hom.preimage_mono r e x.2⟩
